page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance type does not include any bundled local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. For high-throughput networking workloads, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. The lack of local NVMe drives and hardware accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this server for workloads that rely heavily on network-attached storage and CPU-bound processing rather than local disk I/O or parallel GPU computing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge offers high resource density for enterprise-scale applications requiring substantial CPU and memory capacity without the premium cost of specialized GPU or high-speed local storage hardware. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high network throughput make this instance suitable for large-scale web serving, enterprise application hosting, distributed microservices, and general-purpose backend processing.
